hypothesis: A bounded source-only closed-loop fixture pilot design can move the project from HF0 interface scaffolding back toward deployable policy-action evidence without weakening actor input or claim boundaries.
success_criteria: design covers the three M2484 admitted source-only fixtures
design specifies actor source admission and leak checks
design preserves observation shape 72 and action shape 3
design registers a bounded follow-up implementation preflight
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution policy action training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2487 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2487 changes actor input or action contract
M2487 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2487 executes policy action or rollout in the design milestone
M2487 treats canned smoke actions as policy performance
M2487 ranks controller families or selects a winner
M2487 claims high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID result
decision_rule: M2487 passes if it designs a bounded source-only closed-loop fixture pilot and registers an implementation preflight without external simulation, policy action in the design milestone, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
